environment_setting: Country B, City X, where public gatherings are common but heavily regulated to maintain public order
norm_base: Citizens Participating in assembly of 3+ persons likely to cause fear of disturbing peace Liable for unlawful assembly

character_profile.name: Alex Johnson
character_profile.goal: cover a controversial public gathering for a news article

legitimate.legitimate_action: Observing the gathering from a distance without participating
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal consequences, gathers information for the article
legitimate.costs: Limited access to the event, less impactful story

illegal.illegal_action: Joining the gathering to get firsthand experience
illegal.benefits: Gains deeper insights and impactful content for the article
illegal.costs: Liable for unlawful assembly if discovered

character_profile.name: Maria Lopez
character_profile.goal: advocate for community issues through peaceful gatherings

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encouraging participants to disperse peacefully to avoid legal issues
legitimate.benefits: Maintains public order, avoids legal consequences for participants
legitimate.costs: Event may lose impact, participants may feel dissatisfied

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging participants to stay and continue the gathering
illegal.benefits: Raises awareness for the cause, gains public attention
illegal.costs: Liable for unlawful assembly if discovered

legitimate.legitimate_action: Setting up a stall near the gathering without actively participating
legitimate.benefits: Earns income from attendees without legal risks
legitimate.costs: Limited customer base if the gathering disperses quickly

illegal.illegal_action: Actively encouraging the gathering to continue to attract more customers
illegal.costs: Liable for unlawful assembly if discovered
